topic: Reset field progression at the start of every run
currentUserGoal: Fix subsequent runs incorrectly starting on the fully expanded field instead of rebuilding from the inherited one-tile field.
workCompleted: Reset the run objective/mastery state when Begin Next Run creates a new active run.
Confirmed field size, one-tile mastery rank, care RT, wounds, and run tools now reset with each run while permanent GT and purchased Memory upgrades remain.
Corrected the durable redesign and implementation-plan documents: one-tile mastery and field expansion are run-local progression, not session-cumulative progression.
Replaced the obsolete cross-run care-progress test with coverage asserting that a fresh run returns to 1x1 at mastery rank 0.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 34 Vitest tests, TypeScript, and Vite production build.
Browser smoke expanded a run to 2x2 at Ancient Crown, forced dormancy, granted GT, and purchased Soft Touch.
After Begin Next Run, browser debug state reported phase active, activeRootCount 1, activeGridSize 1, mastery rank 0, wakeAncientGrass active, and 0 run touches.
The same second-run state retained 16 permanent GT and the Soft Touch permanent upgrade.
Browser console check reported no errors.
currentGitStatus: Expected after this handoff commit: clean worktree on codex/gameplay-update, one commit ahead of origin/codex/gameplay-update.
knownIssues: The first-run objective module name now understates its role because the same run-local objective sequence is rebuilt every run; renaming it is optional cleanup, not required for behavior.
The 2x2-to-3x3 and wound-pressure chapters still need hands-on pacing feedback after the corrected per-run reset.
nextRecommendedSteps: Have the user confirm that Begin Next Run visibly returns to one tile in their existing browser session.
Play one complete run from 1x1 through 3x3 and tune the post-Crown pressure ramp.
Then add meaningful 2x2 field choices before the 3x3 expansion rather than relying only on the 50 RT threshold.
doNotRevert: Every run must start at 1x1 with mastery rank 0 and rebuild field expansion during that run.
Permanent GT and purchased Memory upgrades must survive the field reset.
Do not restore session-cumulative tile mastery or carry expanded field size through dormancy.
